content:
**Old Crimora Mines** is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Skyline Valley* update.

A part of the quest Oldest Trick in the Book takes place here.

The exterior consists of a small shack and a rock wall with the mine entrance, both of which are covered in runes.

Inside the mines, a railroad track leads to the north, into a small opening with a bonfire and two Cultists standing guard. Past them, a large cave with two floors opens up, with the railroad tracks ending in a northern room. This room has several dead bodies spiked up on wooden poles, as well as a staircase that grants access to the second floor.

On the first floor, outside the room and east of the railroad tracks, are a Cooking Station, a dirty Matress, and a dirty Bed. Further east is a small shrine with a lectern and two benches.

On the second floor are more sleeping opportunities. To the east is a wooden walkway that leads to a smaller cave, to the north is another mine shaft with railroad tracks. Following the tracks leads to a cave that is used to hold prisoners, which can be entered via a wooden walkway.

The door straight ahead leads to a prison cell that has the remains of Eliza. A small walkway inside the cell leads down to a small sacrificial and burial pit, where the remains of Hunter and Dustin are located.

Back outside the cell, a western serpentine connects to another part of the first floor, and passes another prison cell on the way down. Once there, wooden boards lead eastward over a pool of water with more bodies spiked upon poles, and into a tunnel covered with Cultist runes. At the end of the tunnel, another large cave with two floors opens up.

On the first floor, a couple of wooden boards lead down to a platform in the water, which has several praying Cultists next to a bonfire and the deceased body of Patrick. A throne made of pelt and antlers is located on the northeastern wall, with two waterfalls being located on the southeastern wall. A ramp on the northern wall leads up to the second floor, with a walkway
